easyPrerequisites: Ioreth of the Healing House, Arixmethes, and Minamo do not have summoning sickness.
description:
Cast Sylvan Awakening by paying {2}{G}, making Minamo, Arixmethes, and your other lands into land creatures until end of turn.
Activate Arixmethes by tapping it, adding {G}{U}.
Activate Minamo's second ability by paying {U} and tapping it, untapping Ioreth of the Healing House.
Activate Ioreth of the Healing House's second ability by tapping it, untapping Minamo and Arixmethes.
Repeat from step 2.
